notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Brimstone Trebuchet.
Brimstone Trebuchet does not have summoning sickness.
"Knight" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Brimstone Trebuchet by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield as a Knight due to Conspiracy, triggering Brimstone Trebuchet, untapping Brimstone Trebuchet.
Repeat.
